room_block_ended_early_check.name: room_block_ended_early_check
room_block_ended_early_check.value: ("room_operational_block"."ended_early_at" is null) = ("room_operational_block"."original_end_date" is null) and ("room_operational_block"."ended_early_at" is null) = ("room_operational_block"."ended_early_by" is null)

customer_closed_check.name: customer_closed_check
customer_closed_check.value: ("customer"."closed_at" is null) = ("customer"."phone" is not null) and ("customer"."closed_at" is null or not "customer"."is_active")

price_quote_group_counts_check.name: price_quote_group_counts_check
price_quote_group_counts_check.value: case when "price_quote"."booking_type" = 'GROUP' then "price_quote"."male_count" + "price_quote"."female_count" = "price_quote"."total_count" else "price_quote"."male_count" = 0 and "price_quote"."female_count" = 0 end

price_quote_offer_check.name: price_quote_offer_check
price_quote_offer_check.value: not "price_quote"."status" in ('OFFERED', 'ACCEPTED') or ("price_quote"."amount_halalas" is not null and "price_quote"."unit" is not null and "price_quote"."vat_included" is not null and "price_quote"."valid_until" is not null and "price_quote"."offered_at" is not null)

booking_booker_check.name: booking_booker_check
booking_booker_check.value: ("booking"."booker_type" = 'AGENCY' and "booking"."agency_id" is not null and "booking"."customer_id" is null) or ("booking"."booker_type" = 'INDIVIDUAL' and "booking"."customer_id" is not null and "booking"."agency_id" is null)

booking_group_counts_check.name: booking_group_counts_check
booking_group_counts_check.value: case when "booking"."booking_type" = 'GROUP' then "booking"."male_count" + "booking"."female_count" + "booking"."child_count" = "booking"."total_count" else "booking"."male_count" = 0 and "booking"."female_count" = 0 and "booking"."child_count" = 0 end

booking_hold_expiry_check.name: booking_hold_expiry_check
booking_hold_expiry_check.value: not "booking"."status" in ('HELD', 'REQUESTED') or "booking"."hold_expires_at" is not null

booking_confirmed_check.name: booking_confirmed_check
booking_confirmed_check.value: not "booking"."status" in ('CONFIRMED', 'IN_HOUSE', 'COMPLETED') or ("booking"."confirmed_at" is not null and "booking"."receipt_token" is not null)

booking_guest_check_in_check.name: booking_guest_check_in_check
booking_guest_check_in_check.value: "booking_guest"."status" not in ('CHECKED_IN', 'CHECKED_OUT') or "booking_guest"."checked_in_at" is not null

passport_scan_detail_slot_check.name: passport_scan_detail_slot_check
passport_scan_detail_slot_check.value: "passport_scan"."booking_guest_detail_id" is null or "passport_scan"."booking_guest_id" is not null

passport_scan_confirmed_check.name: passport_scan_confirmed_check
passport_scan_confirmed_check.value: "passport_scan"."status" <> 'CONFIRMED' or ("passport_scan"."booking_guest_detail_id" is not null and "passport_scan"."reviewed_at" is not null)
